properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_revised_affected_list_keeps_the_acceptances_on_its_changed_edges.rs, three tests on an in-memory service: the acceptance (accepted_baseline, accepted_seq, checksum_after) is on the CHANGED edge before the revise; add_change_event with one more affected entry keeps it and reports the edge as already present while drawing the new one; a revise that says a different action moves action and keeps the acceptance.
properties.findings: 2026-10-11: on unchanged main (2f60fad38) 2 of 3 failed — adding_an_affected_entry_keeps_the_acceptance_on_the_edges_already_drawn and a_changed_action_moves_and_the_acceptance_still_stays — and the precondition test passed; run twice (once with the fix stashed) with the same result. With the change (2c5366a8a): 3 passed; a_revise_keeps_what_it_was_not_passed (5), a_design_holds_acceptance_says_why_the_code_moved (5) and a_write_replies_with_a_receipt (4) stay green.
